subject.title: Feature: durable natural-language rule learning + explicit multi-mention reply semantics

question: Should OpenClaw introduce a first-class durable conversational rule-governance layer and cross-channel explicit multi-bot mention semantics, or keep these as narrower memory-plugin/channel-plugin improvements?
rationale: The requested behavior crosses memory authority, durable storage, workspace file precedence, conflict handling, and transport delivery policy; current main has useful pieces but no settled product contract for this layer.

options.title: Keep As Design Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-sponsored design that defines rule authority, storage, conflict precedence, and channel mention semantics before implementation.

options.title: Split Into Narrow Feishu And Memory Work
options.body: Treat Feishu self-mention, app-scoped identity, and bot-to-bot delivery as separate channel issues while opening a distinct memory-governance design only if maintainers want that product direction.

options.title: Require Plugin/API Proof First
options.body: Ask for a plugin or memory-plugin prototype and only add core/API surface where current plugin seams are proven insufficient.

recommendation.title: Keep As Design Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-sponsored design that defines rule authority, storage, conflict precedence, and channel mention semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the broadest routing candidate from the sampled history because the issue spans memory/context authority and channel semantics rather than Feishu-only code.
